news_signals.headline: NVIDIA confirms accelerated Blackwell Ultra GPU shipments to all major hyperscalers ahead of Q4 schedule
news_signals.why: Supply timeline de-risking is the single biggest NVDA overhang that just got removed, validating the bull thesis for a quarter-end run to new highs. Directly bullish for NVDA and the entire AI supply chain.

news_signals.headline: Bitcoin spot ETF inflows hit $812M in single day, largest since March - BlackRock IBIT leads
news_signals.why: Record ETF inflows signal renewed institutional demand for Bitcoin exposure, which amplifies directly into MSTR's stock price with 2-3x beta. This is the fuel for the MSTR breakout trade.

news_signals.headline: IonQ awarded $54M DoD quantum networking contract expansion, third government win this year
news_signals.why: Validates IONQ's government revenue model and demonstrates repeatable contract wins. Reduces the pure-speculative narrative and adds real revenue visibility, which squeezes bears who are short the hype.

news_signals.headline: Viking Therapeutics oral VK2735 Phase 3 VENTURE trial enrollment complete, data imminent
news_signals.why: Enrollment completion confirmation removes timeline uncertainty and sets a hard data readout within weeks. Institutions begin pre-positioning, which creates the pre-catalyst drift that makes the trade work.

news_signals.headline: Rocket Lab Archimedes engine passes full-duration hot-fire test at 100% thrust - Neutron development on track
news_signals.why: Removes the biggest technical risk for Neutron development and signals RKLB is on track for its first large rocket launch. This is the de-risking catalyst that institutional investors needed to add exposure.

news_signals.headline: Fed Governor signals comfortable with continued rate cut pace if data cooperates - September cut on track
news_signals.why: Rate cut confirmation is the single biggest catalyst for UPST's loan origination model. Each 25bp cut expands the addressable loan market and improves UPST's conversion rates significantly.

news_signals.headline: PCE inflation data Friday looms as key risk event - consensus expects 2.2% core, any upside surprise could spike VIX
news_signals.why: A hot PCE print above 2.4% would cause a hawkish re-pricing of Fed cuts, spiking VIX and hammering all high-beta names in this portfolio simultaneously. This is the tail risk to watch most carefully.

daily_wisdom: The market rewards those who know when to be aggressive and when to be humble. Cut your losses at your predetermined stop - every time, without negotiation, without hoping. A trader who respects their stop loss is a trader who survives to trade the next setup. The best trade you will ever make is the loss you cut before it became a catastrophe.
risk_warning: EXTREME RISK: Every pick in this list is a highly speculative stock that can lose 20-50% rapidly and without warning. These are momentum and binary event plays, not investments. Only allocate money you are fully prepared to lose entirely. Position sizes of 1-2% of portfolio maximum are stated for a reason - diversification across many small positions is the only risk management in this strategy. This is not financial advice.
